decision.original_usefulness_target: already met by five-sample native CPU acceptance
decision.full_port: not required for the agreed target; separate scalability investment
decision.proposed_next_gate: First de-risk full-domain Metal constraint evaluation; then integrate existing Metal transforms/Merkle with shared CPU witness/accumulation. Require measured complete-proof gain before a full port commitment.
decision.proposed_scalability_gate: If a new 2x complete-throughput objective is selected, roughly 2.42..2.44x effective speedup of the combined constraint/transform/Merkle phases is necessary under the constant-other-cost model; measure the whole job to confirm.
decision.gate_scope: Proposed follow-up criterion, not a user-approved replacement for the original 10M/10-minute goal
decision.defer: GPU witness/accumulation until measured workloads justify them

limitations: Two single verbose diagnostic proofs, not new warm medians; log timing rounds to 0.1 ms.
CPU eval_check is synchronous: eval_check_launch measures its work, not just GPU launch latency.
Merkle timers combine leaf hashing and tree folding; no measured split is available.
Do not sum nested timers; exclusive categories reconcile to segment totals.
Conditional speedups require unmeasured Metal compiler/occupancy/bandwidth behavior; no guaranteed port speedup.
Arithmetic and hashing do not establish BigInt/ECDSA or marketplace workload performance.
